text: This might be silly but I'm watching my niece (5) tonight and something doesn't feel right. Her temperature is 38.4. She's got these tiny dark red-purple dots on her tummy and arms, and when I pressed a glass on them like I've seen on posters they didn't go away at all, you could still see them clearly through it. Her breathing is really fast too, and you can see the skin pulling in under her ribs every time she breathes in. I don't want to overreact but I didn't know who else to ask.
